portaldot-v3.name: Portaldot V3 Testnet
portaldot-v3.notes: From the V3 testnet guide (github.com/ItsCogumellum/portaldot-v3-testnet-guide, 2026-10-02): chainId 420420777, tPOTv3, 14 decimals, EVM via pallet-revive; ss58 42 from its mapped-address example. RPC TODO: the published endpoints were withdrawn on 2026-10-09 (testnet upgrade) — set PORTALKIT_RPC_URL_PORTALDOT_V3 or fill rpcUrl once new ones are announced. Testnet chainId is not final for mainnet. See docs/v3-findings.md.

portaldot-v2.name: Portaldot V2 (native, local node)
portaldot-v2.notes: Local dev node (portaldot_dev --dev). ss58Prefix/decimals match the live mainnet runtime (portaldot 1002), verified via system_properties on 2026-10-02.

portaldot-mainnet.name: Portaldot Mainnet (native)
portaldot-mainnet.notes: Verified 2026-10-02 via system_properties: ss58Format 42, tokenDecimals 14, tokenSymbol POT; runtime portaldot specVersion 1002; no eth_* RPC methods (EVM not enabled).
